# Variable `PACKAGE_NO_LOCALE`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

The PACKAGE_NO_LOCALE variable can be set to “1” to prevent the OpenEmbedded Build System from splitting the locales found in the PKGD directory into split packages.

For example, the `quilt` recipe automatically produces split packages after the do_package task is run. Taking a look inside the WORKDIR directory of `quilt`:

```
$ ls -1 packages-split/
guards
guards-doc
quilt
quilt-dbg
quilt-dev
quilt-doc
quilt-locale-de
quilt-locale-fr
quilt-locale-ja
quilt-locale-ru
quilt-ptest
quilt-src
quilt-staticdev

```

We can see the `quilt-locale-*` packages were automatically generated. Setting PACKAGE_NO_LOCALE to “1” would produce the following packages:

```
$ ls -1 packages-split/
guards
guards-doc
quilt
quilt-dbg
quilt-dev
quilt-doc
quilt-locale
quilt-ptest
quilt-src
quilt-staticdev

```

The `quilt-locale` package contains the merged content of the previous `quilt-locale-*` packages.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-PACKAGE_NO_LOCALE
